about: Findings of tools/ste/ste-lint.mjs that stay. Each exception must have a written reason.
file: the file of the text. key: the key path of a locale text (for a glossary entry: glossary.<id>.term or glossary.<id>.definition). text: for a document, a part of the text of the paragraph.
rule: the rule of the finding. word: optional, the word or the words of the finding.
The tool counts the exceptions. It stops with an error if an exception agrees with no finding (a stale exception).
